target.title: test(gateway): isolate live-event sweep assertion
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The full gateway test shard can leave unrelated stale run contexts in the process-global registry. The worker live-event test asserted the registry-wide sweep count was exactly one, so it failed when other stale contexts existed.

## Why This Change Was Made

Assert the target run context exists before the sweep and is gone afterward. This preserves the test's real contract: sweeping the target context forces the receiver to resync, without coupling the assertion to unrelated global state.

AI-assisted implementation and review.

## User Impact

None. Test-only stabilization; production behavior unchanged.

No changelog entry: test-only change.

## Evidence

- Exact published head: `728569719fa3135b22f3ac56899886a43aa218d7`; base: `e0e0394d05c0f4d7d507b4dd753e96ce4be67510`.
- Earlier focused proof of the identical file blob: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/gateway/worker-environments/live-events.test.ts` — 4 files, 100 tests passed.
- Original PR CI run 29235392005 reproduced the stale-count mismatch twice: expected 1, received 3.
- Manual whole-path review covered registry sweep, target lookup, receiver claim/resync, and adjacent tests; no finding.
- Fresh autoreview helper attempted on the exact patch but the sandbox could not resolve `chatgpt.com`; exact-head hosted CI is the remaining gate.
- `git diff --check`: passed.
